test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 11 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECT pair of the location of the refinery and its state from the following
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tatipaka Refinery – Telangana**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Numaligarh Refinery** is correctly located in **Assam**.
 
• **Tatipaka Refinery** is actually located in **Andhra Pradesh**, not Telangana.
 
• **Bina Refinery** is correctly located in **Madhya Pradesh**.
 
• **Koyali Refinery** is correctly located in **Gujarat**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Refineries play a crucial role in the production of petroleum products and contribute significantly to the economy.
 
• India has several refineries spread across different states to meet the energy demands of the country.
 
• The location of a refinery is often strategic, based on factors such as proximity to crude oil sources, transportation facilities, and market demand.
